candidates.explanation: The exclusion filter uses `id: Not(Number(conditions.userId))`, i.e. it compares the session id against the user id instead of `excludeSessionId`. All of the user's sessions are soft-deleted except one whose session id happens to equal the user id (an unrelated, older session). The current session is deleted, so its next refresh returns 401.

fix.description: Exclude the current session id, not the user id: use `id: Not(Number(conditions.excludeSessionId))`.
